findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the logs bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the amount of data exposed if the key is ever compromised and violates common cryptographic key management requirements.

No explicit key policy is defined, so AWS applies the default policy granting the entire account root full access to the key, meaning any IAM principal in the account that can be granted kms permissions may decrypt log data. An explicit least-privilege key policy restricting decrypt/administration to specific principals should be provided.
